Addis Ababa, Ethiopia — In a major effort to bolster digital economy integration, national policymakers have unveiled expanded infrastructure initiatives across urban and rural transport and payment channels.

The strategic roadmap emphasizes offline-capable mobile service delivery, localized digital content publishing, and open payment interoperability designed to keep essential services accessible even during network throttling or outages.

Industry stakeholders highlighted that digital publishers and news platforms like Gazzette Plus are leading the way by introducing cached content archives, high-contrast outdoor reading themes, and zero-rating bandwidth optimizations for mobile subscribers across Ethiopia.
